# Flashscore
> Flashscore provides real-time live scores, results, fixtures, standings, and match details across football and dozens of other sports worldwide.

Flashscore is a global livescore platform covering major and regional competitions with live match updates, lineups, statistics, standings, draws, and schedules. It is especially strong in football coverage, with dedicated pages for leagues, cups, international tournaments, and country-specific competitions.

## Core Live Scores
- [Football](https://www.flashscore.com/football/): Live football scores, results, fixtures, standings, and match details from leagues worldwide.
- [Tennis](https://www.flashscore.com/tennis/): Live tennis scores, draws, match results, and tournament coverage.
- [Basketball](https://www.flashscore.com/basketball/): Live basketball scores, standings, fixtures, and competition results.
- [Hockey](https://www.flashscore.com/hockey/): Live ice hockey scores, fixtures, standings, and game details.
- [Baseball](https://www.flashscore.com/baseball/): Live baseball scores, results, standings, and schedules from global competitions.
- [Handball](https://www.flashscore.com/handball/): Live handball scores, fixtures, standings, and competition pages.
- [Volleyball](https://www.flashscore.com/volleyball/): Live volleyball scores, results, standings, and tournament schedules.
- [American Football](https://www.flashscore.com/american-football/): Live American football scores, fixtures, and league results.

## Major Football Competitions
- [England](https://www.flashscore.com/football/england/): Live scores and results for Premier League, Championship, cups, and other English competitions.
- [Spain](https://www.flashscore.com/football/spain/): Live scores and results for LaLiga, lower divisions, and Spanish cup competitions.
- [Italy](https://www.flashscore.com/football/italy/): Live scores and results for Serie A, Serie B, and domestic cups.
- [Germany](https://www.flashscore.com/football/germany/): Live scores and results for Bundesliga, 2. Bundesliga, and German cup competitions.
- [France](https://www.flashscore.com/football/france/): Live scores and results for Ligue 1, Ligue 2, and French domestic cups.
- [Europe](https://www.flashscore.com/football/europe/): Live scores and results for UEFA club and international competitions.

- [Europa Conference League](https://www.flashscore.com/football/europe/europa-conference-league/): Live scores and results for UEFA Europa Conference League matches.
- [Euro](https://www.flashscore.com/football/europe/euro/): Live scores, fixtures, standings, and tournament results for the UEFA European Championship.
- [Nations League](https://www.flashscore.com/football/europe/uefa-nations-league/): Live scores, standings, and fixtures for UEFA Nations League competitions.
- [World Cup](https://www.flashscore.com/football/world/world-cup/): Live scores, fixtures, standings, and tournament results for FIFA World Cup matches.

## Match and Competition Features
- [Football Fixtures](https://www.flashscore.com/football/fixtures/): Upcoming football matches and schedules across leagues and tournaments.
- [Football Results](https://www.flashscore.com/football/results/): Completed football match results from competitions around the world.
- [Football Standings](https://www.flashscore.com/football/standings/): League tables and rankings for football competitions worldwide.
- [Football Transfers](https://www.flashscore.com/transfers/): Football transfer news, completed moves, and squad changes.
- [Football Teams](https://www.flashscore.com/teams/): Team pages with fixtures, results, squad information, and recent form.
- [Football Players](https://www.flashscore.com/players/): Player pages with match participation, stats, and competition history.

## User Tools and Account Pages
- [My Games](https://www.flashscore.com/my-games/): Personalized tracked matches, teams, and competitions for quick access.
- [Favorites](https://www.flashscore.com/favourites/): Saved teams, players, and competitions for customized score tracking.
- [News](https://www.flashscore.com/news/): Sports news coverage tied to competitions, teams, and live events.
- [Settings](https://www.flashscore.com/settings/): User preferences for notifications, display options, and score presentation.
